svg.title: Renewable energy curtailment
svg.desc: Simplified original concept map. Branches explain connected dimensions, not a timeline or a claim that one factor guarantees an outcome. Generation: Wind or solar plants can produce electricity when conditions allow. Bottleneck: Network limits or balancing requirements can prevent all available output from being used. Response: Transmission, storage and flexible demand help align supply with use.
svg.text: Wind or solar plants can produce electricity when conditions allow.
Network limits or balancing requirements can prevent all available output
Transmission, storage and flexible demand help align supply with use.
